Liam (CSE): Quick async standup — ACMEHealth renewal flow is failing at webhook -> embeddings lookup since ~02:15 UTC. What I did: triaged customer logs, opened ticket CS-462, isolated failing requests to embedding step. Blockers: need eng confirmation if KV-cache invalidation or model rollout caused ID mismatch; also need a temporary routing/workaround to avoid failed renewals. @Jordan (Eng) @Priya (Eng-ML) can you take a look?
Jordan (Eng): on it, saw the ticket. Can you paste one sample request id and the payload?
Liam (CSE): sample payload below (redacted):
```json
{"request_id":"req_9f3a2b","customer_id":"acmehealth-23","input":"patient summary...","embedding_model":"embed-v3-quant"}
```
IncidentBot: New incident created: CS-462 — "ACMEHealth embeddings lookup failures" (priority: P2).
Priya (Eng-ML): thanks. Quick note: embed-v3-quant was rolled last night in rollout-ramp-7. I can run the sample locally to compare IDs but need the raw vector checksum or the model version that produced the stored key.
Liam (CSE): request_id=req_9f3a2b, header x-routing-hash: ab12ef, stored_key shown in customer log: "emb_key:kv_7721". Also saw repeated 502s from internal embedder in logs.
Jordan (Eng): I can check KV-cache invalidation flow. I'm deep in a release until 11:30am PST but will carve out 30m. If it's a rollout mismatch we can route ACMEHealth to embed-v2 while we investigate.
Priya (Eng-ML): running quick check now — reproducing locally shows a checksum mismatch when using embed-v3-quant vs embed-v2. Internal embedder returned 502 for the payload above at approx 02:14:58 UTC. My quick recommendation: route ACMEHealth to embed-v2 (stable) as a temporary mitigation and enable verbose embedding logs for 24h.
Liam (CSE): sounds good. Action items: 1) Jordan to set routing override for customer -> embed-v2, 2) Priya enable verbose logs + confirm if KV keys can be remapped, 3) I will draft a short proactive note to ACMEHealth explaining rollback and ETA.
Jordan (Eng): plan accepted. Will push routing override and add a canary for 1% first, then 100% after smoke tests. Will also attach the relevant trace: trace_id=tr_44b9. :thumbsup:
Priya (Eng-ML): I will follow up with a short runbook snippet for remapping keys if needed. If KV invalidation is involved we may need to replay the pre-rollout cache populate job.
Marsha (CS Manager): please add customer impact (renewal window) and SLA timeline to CS-462. Tag renewal owner @Elena and mark any billing/commit risk. Keep me posted, Liam.
Liam (CSE): will update CS-462 with impact + contact timeline, pinging Elena. Thanks everyone — I’ll post status update to ACMEHealth once Jordan confirms routing change.
